newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 4.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 4.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Friday:

* On Thursday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average set a new record high, rising 110.43 points or 1.29 percent to close at 7895.81, following the release of a tame employment report which defused worries of a U.S. interest rate hike.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index fell 4.27 points to 1,080.61.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5200/10 a dollar at around 0045 GMT, higher than its Kuala Lumpur ending on Thursday at 2.5240/50.
* Trading is seen focused on second- and third-line stocks, with big-capitalised issues sidelined again, analysts said.
* Property stock Taiping Consolidated and its transferable subscription rights (TSR) seen among top actives again, ahead of September expiry of the TSR.
* Eyes will also be on shipping firm Malaysian International Shipping Corp and air transport firm Transmile Group on lingering speculation that Transmile chairman Mirzan Mahathir is stalking MISC.
